Describe the Issue
Reinstate three ground-floor rooms after an escape of water. Strip-out and drying complete (flooring/skirting removed, plaster sound above 1m). Replaster below 1m, redecorate throughout, new LVT to kitchen and hallway, new carpet to lounge, replace skirting, electrical test to two lounge sockets, biocide treat the hallway cupboard.

Kitchen. Swollen MDF base units under sink; screed damp at meter (location: under sink, lower section; assessment: Beyond economical drying; prolonged water exposure; recommendation: Replace base run, dry void, lay new LVT; claimant claim: Customer says units only 18 months old; severity: moderate).

Lounge. Carpet and underlay lifted and disposed of (location: full floor area; assessment: Beyond economical drying; recommendation: New carpet and underlay, replaster below 1m, replace skirting; severity: moderate). Two sockets on the affected wall need an electrical test before reinstatement.

Hallway. Black mould to understairs cupboard (location: understairs cupboard, low level; assessment: Surface mould growth following prolonged damp; recommendation: Biocide treatment, then make good and redecorate; severity: minor). New LVT to match the kitchen, replace skirting, replaster below 1m.

Access: occupied property, working hours only. Customer has asked for all three rooms to be completed in one visit sequence.
